summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Cultivar ETF (CVAR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that combines top-down and bottom-up analysis to select undervalued, US-listed stocks from a broad spectrum of industries and market-caps. CVAR was launched on Dec 22, 2021 and is issued by Cultivar.

holdings.infoBox: CVAR is an equity ETF with a total of 90 individual holdings. The top holdings are United States Treasury Bills 0% stock at 5.57%, United States Treasury Bonds 2.875% at 3.19%, United States Treasury Bonds 4.625% at 2.90%, Illumina at 2.54%, and Healthcare Services Group at 2.33%.
